11.by: Claude, play.html benchmark() in the Claude desktop browser pane on an Apple M3 laptop (integrated GPU), not a human-observed frame counter
11.note: Two cases on an Apple M3 in the browser pane, 1920x1080 at pixel ratio 1, Medium, GPU forced to finish every frame, camera turning a full circle, 4 aliens mid-hunt. District 10 (Greys, build 13): mean 4.2-4.5 ms, p95 5.2-7.5 ms, 50 draw calls, ~41k triangles. District 91 (Architects, the most expensive species, and the richest coin floor of any belt; build 14): mean 11.9-13.3 ms (75-84 fps), p95 16.1-17.7 ms, 89 draw calls, ~69k triangles -- most of the extra calls are halo sprites on high-value coins, not aliens. The mean clears 60 fps in both; the p95 of the heaviest case sits at the 16.7 ms line, as it did at build 8. Phones: not measured.
